༄༅/ /yam shud dmar po'i phyi rten 'dzugs pa'i cho ga gang bsam 'phrin las lhun grub zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru pu rat+na ye/shin tu gdug ca

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yam shud dmar po'i phyi rten 'dzugs pa'i cho ga gang bsam 'phrin las lhun grub zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru pu rat+na ye/ shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la/ /drag pos 'dul ba'i thabs mkhyen nas/ /mthong ba'i mod la bdud kyi snying / tshal par gcod pa'i gshin rje gshed/ /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs btud nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba po/ /yam shud dmar po 'khor bcas kyi/ /phyi rten 'dzugs pa'i man ngag bshad/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das dpal gshin rje gshed kyi bka' bstod mthu stobs dang drag shul shin tu che zhing / mthu chen stobs 'phrog nag po'i 'phrin las pa kun gyi gtso bo skyes bu dbang gi mdog can gyi phyi rten gzungs 'dzugs kyi lag len ni/ yar ngo mar ngo'i brgyad gnyis dang bcu bzhi gnyis la sogs par gza' skar drag cing rtsub pa'i dus su sgrub khang 'chag 'chag dang byi dor legs par byas la zhing chen bla re yol ba sogs bkram/ bla ma yi dam chos bsrung spyi dang khyad par gnod sbyin lcam sring gi sku bris 'bur gang rung bzhugs su gsol ba'i mtha' skor kun tu stag gzig go khrab gos dar la sogs pa spyan gzigs bkod pa mdzes shing zil che ba'i brgyan la/ stegs mtho ba'i khar yi dam chos bsrung spyi'i gtor ma rang rang gi phyag len bzhin dang / khyad par zangs gzhong la sogs pa'i snod du 'di'i gtor ma khrag chang bdud rtsi ril bu'i khu bas sbrus pa khru gang las mi che zhing tho gang las mi chung ba gru gsum zur dang rtse mo rno ba la mar rgyan ci mdzes phyag mtshan tshang ma'am zungs ral dmar po/ g.yas g.yon du gru gsum de bas chung tsam gnyis/ de gsum gyi phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du de bas chung tsam brgyad/ de dag gi mtha' skor du de bas chung tsam nyer gcig rnams rgyan ci mdzes kyis brgyan pa/ de thams cad khrag gam rmug rtsis kha bsgyur/ sha khrag dang snying sna tshogs kyi mtha' skor smyug sgor gyi mda' 'ug sgros brgyan pa/

gri lcags sam zangs kyi lde'u zur gsum pa glang dmar gyi rgyus pa'i gdams pa'i mgul du dar dmar nag la lcam dral gyi sngags bris pa dang / sku tsa ka le za 'og gi 'phan dang bcas pa btsugs la mañdzi la sogs pa'i stegs kyi khar bzhag de'i g.yas su sman phud/ g.yon du rak+ta/ mdun du gser skyems dbang lnga'i me tog sha chen gu gul ra tshil sogs kyi bdug spos/ zhun chen nam zhun chen bsres pa'i snum nag gi mar me/ mi sogs srog chags du ma'i mkhris pa sbyar ba'i dri chab/ sha sna tshogs bsres pa'i bshos bu gru gsum dkar dmar gnyis sbrengs tshar du bshams pa dang / bag zan la rwa skyes kyi gzugs 'bri smug gi kha bsgyur ba/ gzhan yang sha chen ra sha la phug sgog btsong / 'bras chan khur ba la sogs pa za ba'i rigs sna tshogs dang / ja chang khrag zhag la sogs btung ba'i rigs ci 'byor de thams cad gtsang zhing bkod pa mdzes par bshams/ sgrub khang gi phyir rta/ g.yag ra/ khyi rnams dmar po'am kham bu/ lug nag lcags kha kha dkar rnams kyi sog pa g.yas g.yon du rgya shog la gser ram gri khrag gi lcam dral gnyis kyi srog snying bris pa'i mthar rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas sgrub pa po bdag gi srung ma mdzod la mi nor dgon gnas dang bcas pa'i gnyer mdzod cig khyer ba po la cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston la myur du khug cig ces bris pa 'go nas sgril la dar dmar gyi skud pas dkris/ 'bru sna sman sna rin po che sogs rdzas nyer lnga gang 'dzoms dang lhan cig tu ras sam dar dmar gyi khug mar bcug dar dmar nag gi cod paṇa/ rnga ma dmar po/ stag ras/ e waṃ/ gzig ras/ g.yer kha rnams dang bcas 'jigs 'jigs ltar du brgyan/ skyes bud med chas gos bzang po'i brgyan pas bzung / gzugs de dag dngos su ma 'byor na 'jim pa sogs la bcos la gong gi rgyan rnams btags/ gzhan yang 'og tu dgos pa'i rdor dril/ me tog

nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ bum pa/ rnga cha lang / dung / rkang gling / ru mtshon/ mdung dar la sogs pa dang / sbyang ba'i chas rten rdzas rnams la ster ba'i khrag chang sbyar ba rnams 'dus bya'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams gral la 'khod/ pad+ma dbang chen gyi mngon rtogs shes pa yod na de'i las byang 'dzab bstod kyi bar phyag len bzhin byas la/ bum pa'i nang du las kyi rta mgrin bskyed nas de'i sngags dang a bhi ṣi ka ta brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla zhing / cho ga gzhan rnams yang gsang dkyil chog rnams nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la gtor bsngo bskang ba bstod pa spyi dang khyad par byang lnga gza' gdong gi gtor ma rgyas par phul la 'og nas 'byung ba'i gzungs 'dzugs rnams bya/ yang de dag mi shes pa rnams kyi sgra gdong 'jigs gsum gshed dmar sogs kyi bdag bskyed bum sgrub bya ba dang / yang bde kyai phur pa gur mgon rnams gang rigs kyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas so sor las bum sgrub la gtor bsngo bskang ba rnams phyag len bzhin dang / khyad par 'di'i gtor ma gdan sa 'di rang gi phyag len ltar na zhal gyi rjes sam/ rje tshar chen gyi thugs dam rim pa ltar na pu tra'i rjes su a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha wās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i ngo bo 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi/ rnam pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i sha khrag gi mchod gtor/ dar sna tshogs kyi gur/ rgyu rlon gyi phreng ba/ don snying gi tshal pas brgyan pa'i stong gsum thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ swa bha wās mdun gyi gnas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du byu ru'i sa gzhi zangs ri khrag gi na bun thul bas bskor ba'i dbus su bh+rūṃ las bse mkhar smug po gru bzhi sgo bzhi mchong gi ba gam rus pa'i sham bu'i brgyan pa'i bar snang la mi mgo rgyu rlon ro skra thod pa rnams kyi drwa ba drwa phyed rnga g.yab zla phyed cha lang gi tshul du brgyan pa/

keng rus kyi thog phyur bur phubs pa'i rtser tsit+ta'i tog zur bzhir mi ro'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/ sgo bzhir byu ru dmar po'i them skas g.yu ra gan gyi ru bzhi/ zangs kyi sgo glegs can gyi nang du thod skam gyi rwa ba zlum po sgo gcig pa khrag gis byugs shing / g.yang gzhi'i bla re/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi rus pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa'i phyi'i nam mkha' la sprin dmar 'brug sgra can glog dang khrag ser 'babs pa/ ser khra dung khra lcags khra pho rog 'ug pa srin bya thal mdog rnams 'jigs pa'i skad dang rnam 'gyur du ma ston pa/ 'og gzhi me rlung 'khyil zhing mi rta'i ro khrag bsur chen gyi dud pas gang ba'i gzhi la ro langs 'byung po keng rus sha za la sogs pa rnams rgyug cing ha ha'i gad rgyangs khus 'debs dgra ming 'bod cing bro khrab 'thab rtsod sogs 'jigs tshul ston pa dang / gzhan yang stag gzig dred 'phar ba lce spyang mgo dgu la sogs pa dur khrod kyi gcan gzan rnams mi sdug pa'i nga ro sgrog pa'i gang ba'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su rta khrag dang mi khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po dmar la dwangs pa/ rba klong gru gsum bsnol mar 'khrug pa'i dbus su zangs ri gru bzhi pa'i steng pad nyi mi rta'i ro brtsegs pa'i gdan la praṃ las zangs kyi ral gri praṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnod sbyin chen po sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing 'od 'phro ba/ sbom thung yan lag rags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu bgrad cing me stag 'phro ba/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa'i nang nas khrag dron 'khol zhing skan sgra tog pa'i ljags 'gril ba/ sma ra dang smin ma kham pa me ltar 'bar zhing dbu skra ltag par bcings pa/ zangs rmog dar dmar gyi 'gying thod can gsol ba/

g.yas zangs ral 'bar ba 'phyar zhing / g.yon mda' gzhu dang dgra bgegs kyi glo snying khrag 'dzag 'dzin pa'i mchan khung na byu ru'i dbyug pa/ bse mdung dar dmar gyi ru mtshon can 'phyar ba/ sku la dar dmar gyi ral dgu zangs khrab/ ra dmar gyi g.yang gzhi rnams ji ltar 'tshams pa gsol ba la/ mi mgo rlon pa khrag 'dzag gi do shal byas pa/ zhabs la sag ri dmar pos r+b+pa 'bog gsol ba/ mi sdug pa'i gzugs can srid pa gsum gyi skye 'gro su zhig gi mthong kyang de ma thag snying 'gas par nus pa'i sku can/ g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyi me rlung 'khrug pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du pad+ma nyi ma dgra bgegs kyi ro gdan la maṃ las srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma sku mdog sngo nag gdong pa bse/ so dung / smin ma g.yu/ mi'i ral pa la mchong dang mu men gyis brgyan pa/ gser gyi rna cha can/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche pa gtsigs pa/ g.yas zangs kyi ral gri dgra la 'phyar zhing / g.yon lcags kyi phur pa bgegs la 'debs pa/ mi mgo skam rlon sbrul dang rus pa'i dbu dang phyag zhabs sku lus rnams brgyan pa/ dar nag gi na bza' dang mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gsol zhing dred mo mi zan la zhon pa/ dam nyams kyi srog dbugs la rngams pa'o/ /gtso bos g.yas su khrag mtsho'i dkyil du traṃ las las mkhan srog bdag dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mdung dmar ba dan dang bcas pa 'phyar zhing / g.yon btsan gyi zhags pa dgra la 'debs pa/ bse khrab dang bse rmog gyon nas lce spyang la zhon pa/ mtshan mo rgyu zhing dgra bgegs la 'o dod 'bod pa/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi shar du mi dmar phra ma/ lhor ri tsi mi dmar/ nub tu kro ti mi dmar/ byang du srog bdag kau sha shar lhor aṅkir mi dmar/ lho nub tu ro kri mi dmar/ nub byang du ha sham mi dmar/ byang shar du srog bdag thal ba ste/ brgyad ka'ang sku mdog dmar po gshin rje khros pa'i cha lugs can/

gcer bu liṅga 'greng ba/ zangs gri dang thod pa 'dzin cing sha khrag la rngams pa'o/ /de rnams kyi phyi rol tu bshan pa ma ru rtse/ srog gcod bdud kyi bu/ las bdud du ru ki srin po mi zan/ gshin rje stag thabs/ srin po mi reng / sog po sha zan/ mi dmar bshan pa/ tho ba gying bdag dung gi rdo rje/ sgrol gying dbang bsdud/ gying chen rta khrid/ rdo rje gying chen/ srog bdag la li/ bshan pa mi zan/ 'jigs byed rdo rje/ shugs sgrol mgyogs byed/ legs nyes btang 'dzin/ bdud po sha zan/ gshin rje stag mgo can/ bshan pa glang mgo can ste thams cad kyang mdog dmar po/ gshin rje'i gzugs can g.yas zangs gri kho na 'phyar zhing / g.yon pa rnams kyi rgyu ma/ glo/ snying / klad pa/ sha khrag rkang mar la sogs pa za ba dang / dgra lpags shu ba/ sha stan 'ding ba sogs rnam 'gyur du ma ston pa'i lus la mi lpags glang ko thod sbrul gyi brgyan pa'o/ /gzhan yang btsan bdud gnod sbyin srin po nad bdag the'u rang dregs byed dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa so so'i rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pas sha la dga' zhing khrag la rol ba bstan pa srung ba'i las la brtson pa nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang ba/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas byang shar dbang ldan ma ru rtse'i dur khrod brag dmar mchong lding gi pho brang nas gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje g.yab dril bu sil/ mi rkang gi sgra dang bcas pas/ kyai phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi na/ /nyi ma byang shar mtshams bshad nas/ /srog bdag dmar po spyan 'dren no/ /sgrol gying chen po gshegs su gsol/ /me rlung 'tshub pa'i pho brang dbus/ /rak+ta khrag gi rgya mtsho nas/ /srid pa'i bu mo spyan 'dren no/ /gar gyi dbang phyug gshegs su gsol/

/srin po khros pa'i pho brang dbus/ /drag po sgrol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /las mkhan dmar po spyan 'dren no/ /rgyug byed pho nya gshegs su gsol/ /rab tu rngams pa'i pho brang nas/ /khrag mtsho 'khyil ba'i khor yug las/ /gri thogs brgyad po spyan 'dren no/ /bshan pa nyer gcig gshegs su gsol/ /brag dmar mchong lding pho brang nas/ /bdud btsan gnod sbyin srin po dang / /ma mo the'u rang spyan 'dren no/ /dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol/ /ma thogs myur bar las la byon/ /ring ba'i tshul gyi mchod gtor bzhes/ /bdag gi bcol ba'i phrin las rnams/ /ma g.yel myur du sgrub par mdzod/ /rak+mo pra ṇa at+ma sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ pad+ma kā ma la ya satwaṃ/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /ma rung 'dul phyir drag pos skur bstan nas/ /mthu stobs phun tshogs bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i/ /sgrol gying srog bdag dmar po la phyag 'tshal/ /bka' yi 'khor gnas ye shes bsrung ma'i tshogs/ /rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i bde ster gsang ba'i yum/ /las byed bshan pa gtum po sde lnga dang / /ma mo the'u rang tshogs la gus pas 'dud/ /rak+mo pra ṇa at+ma sa pa ri wā ra a ti pu hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ rak+mo pra ṇa at+ma sa pa ri wā ra sa mā ya sma ra/ sa mā ya mā ti kra ma/ sa mā ya rak+ṣan+tu/ gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams gshin rje gshed/ ma hā de wa/ e ka dza ṭi/ a tsar+ya nyi 'od grags pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba nag po/ paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ mar pa lo tsā ba/ dpal ldan grub thob zla phyar la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srung / bstan pa skyong zhes pa nas/ 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol gyi bar gur zhal gyi dam bzhag bzhin la thal brdeb bcas/

de nas so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ rak+mo pra ṇa at+ma sa pa ri wā ra a/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ naiwi d+ye/ shap+ta/ rū pa/ shap+ta/ gan+dhaṃ/ rā sa/ par+ṣe pra tits+tsha hūm̐/ zhes dang / mtheb srin gyi nang mchod gtor la/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ma hā rak+ta pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ gnod sbyin 'khor bcas kyi ljags rdo rje'i 'od kyi sbu gu'i gtor ma gsol bar bsam la/ rak+mo pra ṇa'i mthar/ sarba bigh+nan sha trun a mu ka ma ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ gri ha na kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye pa'i mthar se gol gtogs pa lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ rak+mo pra ṇa'i mthar/ a nas shap+ta'i bar gyi mchod/ rak+mo pra na'i mthar sman raka gi sngags btab la de gnyis kyang phul/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / sogs gur zhal gyi gtor bsngo bzhin no/ /bzlas pa bya ba ni/ gnod sbyin gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du praṃ gyi mthar oṃ rak+mo pra ṇa'i sngags kyi bskor ba dang / lha mo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du bh+yo'i mthar rak+mo ya ma'i sngags kyi bskor bar bsam la/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros pa lcam dral gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la phog bas dbang du 'dus shing ji ltar bsgo ba'i phrin las sgrub par bsam la/ bdag bskyed gang yin de'i sngags ji ltar rigs pa'i mthar/ oṃ pra ṇa at+ma k+ṣe ru pu ru ṣa/ lu hi ta sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rak+mo ya ma tsit+ta dz+wa la raṃ pra ti de wi hūm̐/ srog la yaṃ dza sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad phaṭa/ gzungs la ster ba'i khrag chang la'ang sngags btab/༈ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs ji ltar rigs pa bzla'o/ /yang gtor bsngo 'di gur zhal sogs dang sbrel nas nyams su blang ba yin na zhal gyi rjes sam pu tra'i rjes la 'di'i sngags dang /

de nas dkar bdud phur srung sogs nas mchod pa phrin bcol bshags pa rnams rgyun bzhin/ bskang rdzas byin rlabs bzung ste chos bsrung so so'i bskang ba dang 'di'i bskang ba rnams so so'i phyag len bzhin bya/ yang gnod sbyin lcam dral 'di kho na la gtor bsngo byas tshe bzlas pa rdzogs rjes bskang rdzas a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig le brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i rta dmar rlung gi shugs can/ g.yag rgod kham pa 'gying ba/ bdud lug nag po spyi dkar/ bse'i rwa skyes dmar po/ khyi dmar stag ltar rngams pa/ mi dmar stobs chen las kun byed pa/ srin bya 'ug pa la sogs pa'i btsan bya mang po khyung ltar lding ba/ gzhan yang dmar chen gtor ma ri ltar spungs pa/ khrag rgod gser skyems mtsho ltar 'khyil ba/ phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba zab pa dbyings su ro gcig pa byed las gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa gnyis nas las thams cad 'bad med du sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ sarba bita pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a warta ya a warta ya ho/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes brjod la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gtogs/ rnga rol mi rkang gi gling bu/ bsur chen gyi dud pa sogs zil che ba byas la 'dur dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ lha mchog sgrol ging chen po mthu bo che/ /phrin las drag pos gdug pa tshar gcod cing / /byang shar mya ngan med pa'i gnas mchog nas/ /lcam dral 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dam nyams rnams kyi srog gcod mdzad tsa na/ /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas༞ /gnod sbyin dgra bgegs thal bar brlog tsa na/ /rgya nag ha shang yul nas༞ /dam tshig ldan pa'i srung ma mdzad tsa na/ /ma ru rtse'i gnas nas༞ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i bang mdzod skyong tsa na/

/li yul khams kyi yul nas༞ /ma mo rnams kyi gtso mo mdzad tsa na/ /bod yul zal mo gangs nas༞ /rnal 'byor bdag gi dgra lha mdzad tsa na/ /dar lung brag ram gnas nas༞ /stobs 'phrog dbang po'i phrin las skyongs tsa na/ /kha 'ub brag rdzong gnas nas༞ /rje btsun bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i tshe/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gnas 'dir da lta byon/༈ yul phyogs gzhan du gtong ba'i tshe nas gshegs su gsol zhes sbyar/ /sngon tshe gshin rje gshed kyi spyan snga ru/ /gnod sbyin khyod kyi ji ltar khas blang ltar/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ rak+mo pra ṇa at+ma sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas sprin phung thibs pa bzhin byon par bsam/ hūm̐ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i gzhal yas 'dir/ /mi rta 'bum gyi ro gdan brtsegs pa'i steng / /gnod sbyin 'khor bcas dges shing brtan bzhugs nas/ /sman raka phud kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /sngags kyi mthar pad+ma kā ma la satwaṃ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta a pra tits+tsha swāhā/ gtor ma phul/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ phrin las bcol ba rnams byas la/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ hūm̐ lha mchog sgrol 'gying chen po mthu bo che/ /khyed la mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /g.yag rgod kham pa ri ltar 'gyings pa dang / /khyi dmar 'brug sgra stag ltar rngams pa dang / /lug nag kha dkar shel ltar 'tsher ba dang / /rwa skyes dmar po yid du 'ong ba dang / /rta mchog dmar po sprin gyi shugs can dang / /srin bya 'ug pa khyung ltar lding ba dang / /mi dmar stobs ldan lam kun byed pa rnams/ /dmar nag dar gyi cod paṇa mang pos spras/ /lha mchog sgrol 'gying chen pos thugs dam bskang / /skyes bu dbang gi mdog can thugs dam bskang / /sgrol byed srog bdag dmar po༞ /ging chen yam shud dmar pos༞

/dpal ldan beg tse can gyi༞ /ma gcig gdong dmar lha mo'i༞ /srid pa'i ma mo chen mo'i༞ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug༞ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung chen po'i༞ /las mkhan srog bdag dmar pos༞ /gri thogs ging chen brgyad kyi༞ /rol bshan nyi shu rtsa gcig༞ /bka' nyan gnod sbyin 'bum sde'i༞ /las byed ma mo 'bum sde'i༞ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skang gyur nas/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob nyams chags gsol gyur cig /rak+ta dmar chen khrag gi a dang / /dam nyams dbang po lnga yi me tog dang / /tshil chen klad rkang bsregs pa'i bdug spos dang / /zhun chen til mar sbra ba'i sgron me dang / /khrag zhag mkhris pa'i dri chab rgya mtsho dang / /don snying sha rus spungs pa'i zhal zas mchog /rkang gling thod rnga snyan pa'i dbyangs la sogs/ /sna tshogs drag po'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'dis/ /lha mchog sgrol ging chen pos thugs dam bskang / /skyes bu dbang gi mdog can༞ /sgrol byed srog bdag dmar pos༞ /ging chen yam shud dmar pos༞ /dpal ldan beg tse can gyi༞ /ma gcig gdong dmar lha mo'i༞ /srid pa'i ma mo chen mo'i༞ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug༞ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung chen po'i༞ /las mkhan srog bdag dmar po'i༞ /gri thogs ging chen brgyad kyi༞ /rol bshan nyi shu rtsa gcig༞ /bka' nyan gnod sbyin 'bum sde'i༞ /las byed ma mo 'bum sde'i༞ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skang gyur nas/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob nyams chags gsos gyur cig /dam rdzas dmar chen bshos bu rgyan ldan dang / /khrag zhag 'bru bcud stong gi khu ba dang / /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman gyi mchog /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i snying khrag dron mo 'di/ /snod mchog tshad ldan ban+dha rab bkang ba/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs pa'i/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i mchod gtor chen po dang / /'ug sgros brgyan pa'i mda' la dar dmar bcas/ /lug nag kha dkar tsit+ta rdzas kyi bskang /

/rnam par bkra ba'i mtshon chas phyogs kun khyab/ /dur khrod ras la tshad ldan bris sku dang / /seng ldeng zangs kyi phur pa sor brgyad pa/ /smyug rgod tshigs dgu rtsa rtse rdo rjes brgyan/ /dung gi sho long mig dgu la sogs pa/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas mchod sprin tshogs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /lha mchog sgrol ging chen pos༞ /skyes bu dbang gi mdog can༞ /sgrol byed srog bdag dmar po'i༞ /ging chen yam shud dmar po'i༞ /dpal ldan beg tse can gyi༞ /ma gcig gdong dmar lha mo'i༞ /srid pa'i ma mo chen mo'i༞ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug༞ /dpal ldan khrag thung chen po'i༞ /las mkhan srog bdag dmar po'i༞ /gri thogs ging chen brgyad kyi༞ /rol bshan nyi shu rtsa gcig༞ /bka' nyan gnod sbyin 'bum sde'i༞ /las byed ma mo 'bum sde'i༞ /'khor dang bcas pas thugs dam bskang gyur nas/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob nyams chags gsos gyur cig /dregs pa lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung zhing skyong ba dang / /gnod byed dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /zhi rgyas dbang drag dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /hoḥbade chen chos sku snang ba mtha' yas dang / /longs sku khro rgyal pad+ma dbang gi lha/ /sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma dgongs su gsol/ /byang shar mya ngan med pa'i zhing khams nas/ /yam shud dmar po srog bdag kun gyi gtso/ /lcam dral bran g.yog bka' bstod pho nyar bcas/ /mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje'i bdag la dgongs/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chags rnams/ /chos skyong chen po khyed la mthol lo bshags/ /khyed kyi bsten pa'i dam rdzas ma sgrub dang / /sgrub par 'os ba'i bsnyen sgrub g.yel ba dang / /dus kyi mchod gtor chag dang zhan pa sogs/

/dam can srung ma khyed la mthol lo bshags/ /dam nyams sdig can rnams dang tshogs 'dres shing / /skal dman snod du ma gyur gang zag la/ /khyod kyi gsang sngags zab mo sgrags pa sogs/ /rab nongs 'gyod pa'i sems kyi mthol lo bshags/ /mdor na sgo gsum bag med dbang gyur pas/ /srung ma khyed kyi thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /mkha' la na bun dwangs pa ji bzhin du/ /skye med chos dbyings ngang du zhi gyur cig /khyed thugs dges pa chen pos rgya mtsho las/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i rba rlabs cher g.yo ba'i/ /dngos grub yid bzhin nor bu'i dga' ston gyi/ /sgrub mchog phun tshogs re smon 'grub par mdzod/ /kyai yaṃ shud dmar po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /mdo rgyud bstan pa rin chen skyong ba dang / /khyad par sa skya'i rje btsun bstan pa 'di/ /mi nyams dbyar mtsho lta bu rgyas par mdzod/ /de 'dzin gang zag mchog rnams zhabs brtan cing / /dge 'dun sde rnams bshad sgrub rgyas pa dang / /'jig rten khams kyi mi mthun rgud tshogs zhi/ /'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs par mdzod/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen rgyas pa dang / /mdo sngags lung rtogs yon tan yar zla bzhin/ /'phel zhing khams gsum ma lus dbang bsdud mdzod/ /bla ma la sdang sems can kun la 'tshe/ /zhing bcu tshang ba'i gzugs can gzugs med rnams/ /lo zla ma 'gyangs myur du tshar bcad nas/ /mdor na ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /hūm̐ khyed la phrin las zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ /rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la bar gcod pa'i/ /lha klu gnod sbyin grul bum la sogs pa'i/ /gdon chen stong phrag brgyad cu bzlog tu gsol/ /rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa la sogs pa'i/ /nad rims bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi༞ /'jigs shing skrag dang dngangs pa la sogs pa'i/

/ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu༞ /chu tshod drug cu rtsa bzhi'i bar gcod pa'i/ /glo bur drug cu rtsa bzhi༞ /sngon las 'phral rkyen gnyis kyi bsdus pa yi/ /rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong༞ /rnal 'byor tshe tshad phul du ma 'khyol bar/ /dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad༞ /rmongs byed rengs byed rmugs byed brgyal ba sogs/ /shis ngan gum pa bco brgyad༞ /phywa dang dbang phyug la sogs phyi rol pa'i/ /srid pa'i khram kha thams cad༞ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad la sogs pa'i/ /lha 'dre'i dmag tshogs༞ /ma mo'i khrag zor gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor dang / /bdud kyi khram la btab pa༞ /phur pa'i gdab las gnod sbyin gzer nad dang / /rgyal po'i smyo 'bog gtong ba༞ /btsan gyi gya gyu mon pa'i gcer rgyugs dang / /'ba' mo'i gru mtshon brdebs pa༞ /'byung po'i thod gzor zhang zhung btso dmar dang / /skyes pa'i mda' gzor 'phen pa༞ /dngos dang nyams dang rmi lam mtshan ma ngan/ /ro langs 'byung po'i gnod pa༞ /lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skag la sogs/ /skyes pa'i skar ma'i gnod pa༞ /phyogs ngan bdud gcod bzhi gshed spar phung dang / /mo ltas rtsis zur ngan pa༞ /spyang khu ngu zhing wa brgyal srin bya rgod/ /gzhan gyi cho 'phrul gtong ba༞ /bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus pa/ /dam can khyed kyi myur du sgrub par mdzod/ /ces brjod la/ srog sngags kyi mthar/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin bcol rang rang gi blo 'dod bzhin sbyar/ /bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ mi bzad rgyal ba'i drag po'i phrin las kun/ /gcig bsdus ma rung tshar gcod gnod sbyin dbang / /yaṃ shud dmar po dam nyams zhing bcu'i gshed/ /rnal 'byor dgra lha chen por bstod par bgyi/ /gang sku byi ru'i lhun po rdul bral la/ /dus mtha'i me dpung 'bar ba'i gzi mdangs 'phro/ /bdud sde ma lus tsit+ta tshal par 'gas/ /sgeg pa dpa' bos gzugs khyod bstod par bgyi/

/zhal dkyil gshin rje khros 'dra mche ba gtsigs/ /ljags bskyod drag po'i spyan gsum dgra la gzir/ /shangs nas 'thor rlung drag pos stong gsum 'gengs/ /log 'dren bdud kyi gshed khyod༞ /rab dmar snyan shal rus ba'i rna chas brgyan/ /dbu skyes ltag bcings zangs rmog thod du 'gyings/ /thod skam dbu rgyan mgo rlon do shal can/ /drag gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs khyod༞ /sku la zangs kyi beg tse dmar po dang / /rwa skyes g.yang gzhi khrag 'dzag lding stabs gyon/ /sag ri'i r+b+pa 'bog zhabs zung mdzes par brgyan/ /mi zad 'jigs pa'i rgyan 'chang༞ /phyag g.yas zangs ral 'bar ba nam mkhar 'phyar/ /phyag g.yon dgra bgegs glo snying thugs kar 'dzin/ /ru mtshon byur dbyug mda' gzhu mchan du thogs/ /dam ldan bstan srung dbang por༞ /khro 'khrugs rngams pa'i zhabs zung brkyang bskum gyis/ /rta dmar dam nyams dbugs bral gdan steng du/ /'gying zhing brdzis pa'i tshul gyi rnam par bzhugs/ /skyes bu dbang gi mdog can༞ /skyes bu khyod kyi rta zur g.yon phyogs su/ /rab gtum dred mo mi zad 'gying ba'i khrir/ /'jigs gzugs srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ /srin mo khros ba'i gzugs can༞ /zhal dkyil bse yi rang bzhin dmar zhing snum/ /rno dkar dung gi mche gtsigs smin ma g.yu/ /ljags bskyod spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug /srid pa'i ma mo chen mor༞ /me ral mchong dang mu men rgyan gyis mdzes/ /thod skam dbu rgyan mgo rlon do shal can/ /dar nag gos kyi lhab lhub sku la gsol/ /srin mo gdong dmar ma khyod༞ /g.yang gzhi khrag 'dzag lding stabs gyon zhing 'jigs/ /rus pas rgyan cha sbrul nag chun pos dkris/ /ba spu'i khung nas nad kyi 'tshub ma ldang / /srid gsum dal yams bdag mo༞ /phyag g.yas zangs kyi ral gris dgra srog gcod/ /phyag g.yon lcags kyi phur bus bgegs dpung 'joms/ /rab khros brkyang bskum zhabs kyi gar stabs g.yo/

/pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug༞ /yaṃ shud dmar po'i g.yas kyi sta zur du/ /rgyags shing dregs pa'i ce spyang sngon po'i steng / /btsan mchog srog bdag dmar po sde brgyad gtso/ /bstan dgra sdig can bshan par༞ /sku mdog bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i gzi/ /khro gnyer glog stong 'khyug cing am gtsigs bsdams/ /'jigs pa'i sdang mig phyogs bcu kun tu g.yo/ /dgra snying phye mar 'gems khyod༞ /dbu la bse rmog me 'od 'bar ba gsol/ /sku la nyi gzhon mdangs ldan bse khrab bsnams/ /phyag g.yas mdung dmar g.yon pa btsan zhags 'dzin/ /ma rung thal bar rlog khyod༞ /gtso 'khor gsum gyi mtha' bskor khrag mtsho'i nang / /gri thogs brgyad dang ro bshan nyi shu gcig /bdud dang gnod sbyin srin po khros pa'i gzugs/ /drag gtum 'bar ba'i 'khor tshogs༞ /kun kyang pad rāg lhun por tsha zer 'od/ /'jigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /dam nyams dgra bo skad cig nyid la sgrol/ /ma rung las bshan tshogs rnams༞ /gzhan yang gnod sbyin dbang po khyod kyi 'khor/ /btsan bdud ma mo the'u rang gshin rje sogs/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ /mthu stobs dpag med ldan kun༞ /yam shud khyod kyi thub pa'i bstan pa bsrungs/ /de 'dzin dge 'dun sde bcas bu bzhin skyongs/ /'jig rten bde skyid yar ngo'i zla ltar spel/ /bcol ba'i las rnams 'bad med 'grub par mdzod/ /khyad par rdo rje 'chang dngos tshar pa rje'i/ /snyan brgyud bstan pa rin chen phyogs bcur spel/ /de la 'khu ba'i dam nyams sdig can tshogs/ /ma thogs ring pa'i tshul gyi myur du sgrol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams/ /'di phyi bar do'i grogs por khyod 'tshol na/ /tshe ring nad med sa lam kun sgrod nas/ /rdor 'dzin go 'phang thob pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /de nas rdo rje'i glu bkra shis smon lam gyi bar byas la/

phyi rten rnams kyi drung du sbyangs chas la sogs pa dgos pa'i yo byad rnams khyer la/ rnga brdungs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /zhes sogs gtor bsngo nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ zhi ba dang zhi drag phyed ma dang khro bo spyan 'dren sngon 'gro'i drag po'i sbyangs ba rnams gzhan dang 'dra ba las/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'dir gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i rten 'dzugs pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad gtor ma lam brngan/ ting lo lam sgron sogs dang / bden brdar gyi tshe/ na mo rje btsun nas/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang zhes pa'i bar gzhan dang 'dra ba las/ bdag bskyed gang blang gi yi dam gyi mtshan nas brjod la/ 'di zhes bya ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang / gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyi sogs gzhan 'dra/ de nas rten khrus/ phar phyin drug gi tshigs bcad/ gang la ser sna ma dang bcas pa'i tshigs bcad rnams kyi khrus gsol dang shis brjod byas la gzungs rnams la bum chu gtor te amṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i rta dmar rlung gi shugs can zhes pa nas btsan bya mang po khyung ltar lding pa zhes pa'i bar bskang rdzas byin rlabs bzhin khyung ltar lding ba rnams dbang po tshang zhing rgyan gyis brgyan pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba zab pa/ dbyings su ro gcig pa byed las gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes par byed cing dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs sngags drug phyag drug ting nge 'dzin drug gi byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthar rnga brdung dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/

hūm̐ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' yis/ /khams lnga las grub gzugs can 'di/ /khyed kyi phyi yi rten du 'bul/ /bzhes nas dam tshig bsrung du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ hūm̐ lha mchog sgrol ging chen po yam shud dmar po/ skyes bu dbang gi mdog can/ srog bdag gnod sbyin chen po/ ging chen zangs kyi beg tse/ srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan khrag 'thung chen po/ las mkhan srog bdag dmar po/ gri thogs gying chen gri thogs rnam brgyad/ rol bshan nyi shu rtsa gcig myur mgyogs can gyi dmag dpung / srog gcod bdud nag stong dang / sha zan gshin rje'i tshogs dang / mi sdug gnod sbyin tshogs dang / srog gcod srin po'i tshogs dang / nad bdag ma mo'i tshogs dang / phung byed the'u rang stong la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs ye shes gsal ba'i spyan dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul myur ba'i zhabs dang ldan pa/ dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ rig 'dzin kun gyi srog shing / gtsug lag khang gi srung ma/ dug gsum nad kyi sman pa 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams gshin rje gshed/ ma hā de wa/ e ka dza ṭi/ a tsar+ya nyi 'od grags pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba nag po/ paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ mar pa lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ dpal ldan grub thob zla phyar la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar gzungs chen 'di rnams brtan par bzhugs shing bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ bla ma'i sku tshe bsrings/ 'jig rten gyi khams su dge legs rgya chen po 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du yang rje btsun sa skya pa'i sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa mi nyams dbyar mtsho lta bur rgyas pa dang / bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod la mi brgyud chu bo las ring ba/

tshe srog rdo rje las bsra ba/ dpal 'byor rnam thos bu dang mnyam pa/ bsam pa'i don thams cad chos ldan du 'grub pa/ rgyal po yul 'khor grong khyer rnams dang / 'byung po thams cad dbang du mdzod cig sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs thams cad skad cig tsam gyi myur du sgrol cig rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su skyol cig mthu ma chung zhig rtsal ma zhan cig 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa myur du stsol cig zhes lan gsum brjod la so so'i mthar drag rol spos bdug gser skyems gtor/ lcam dral gyi srog sngags brjod do/ /de nas dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ hūm̐ g.yag dmar gzhol chen sprin ltar 'thibs pa 'di/ /mdzes pa'i spu sdug rwa dang rnga g.yab can/ /dmar nag dar gyi cod paṇa mang pos brgyan/ /gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas ma mo nag mo 'di/ /mdzes pa'i spu sdug kha skya spyi dkar ma/ /dmar nag dar gyi cod paṇa༞ /gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor dang༞ /rwa skyes dmar po lcags kyi rwa rmig can/ /mdzes pa'i spu sdug 'tsher ba'i skad bsang sgrog /dmar nag dar gyi cod paṇa༞ /gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor dang༞ /rta mchog dmar po sprin gyi shugs can 'di/ /mdzes pa'i spu sdug ze rngog brjid dang ldan/ /dmar nag dar gyi cod paṇa༞ /gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor༞ /stag ltar rngams pa'i khyi dmar dung so༞ /mdzes pa'i spu sdug dregs pa'i nga ro sgrog /dmar nag dar gyi cod paṇa༞ /gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor༞ /btsan bya 'ug pa bse khra dung khra sogs/ /mdzes pa'i spu sdug mkha' la khyung ltar lding / /dmar nag dar gyi cod paṇa༞ /gnod sbyin lcam dral༞ /mi dmar stobs chen srin po'i cha lugs can/ /las kun sgrub la rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan 'di/ /dmar nag dar gyi cod paṇa༞ /gnod sbyin lcam dral༞ /bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i go khrab dang /

/ma rung log 'dren 'joms pa'i mtshon cha dang / /dkar phyogs rtag tu rgyal ba'i ru mtshon rnams/ /gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor dang༞ /myos byed stong gi bcud bsdus dza gad dang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i snying khrag dron mo dang / /bsur chen dud pa sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra/ /gnod sbyin lcam dral༞ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshang ma 'di dag gis/ /khyed kyi thugs dam gnyen po skong gyur nas/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /dre med 'khon gyi gdung brgyud 'byon pa dang / /gong ma'i bzhed srol bshad sgrub dar ba dang / /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen kun sel mthun rkyen 'grub pa dang / /nag phyogs bdud kyi bar chad kun zhi nas/ /dge legs 'dod dgu'i dpal la rol bar mdzod/ /yang / hūm̐ lha mchog sgrol ging chen po yam shud dmar po zhes pa nas ma lus pa myur du stsol cig zhes pa'i bar lan gsum/ sngags rol bdug pa gser skyems 'thor ba'i bar gong bzhin byas la/ slob dpon gyi chos skyong gi gtor ma bzung nas rten rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pa'am/ bzhag pa'i mos pa byas la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs shing / /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /gtor ma dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob nas/ /khams gsum ma lus 'dul gyur cig /oṃ rak+mo pra ṇa at+ma sa pa ri wā ra ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dang / lcam dral gyi srog sngags brjod la drag rol dang bcas pas dbang bskur khrag chang la sngags btab la blud/ yang rnga brdungs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ rnam dag rgyu rkyen las grub cing / /sna tshogs rgyan gyis legs spras pa/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur ba'i/ /phyi rten 'di ni 'bul bar bgyi/ /gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor bcas kyi/ /spyan lam 'byung zhing mnyes gyur nas/

/rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin gyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi nyer 'tshe zhi/ /legs tshogs yar ngo'i zla ltar spel/ /brtan g.yo'i phun tshogs ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa dang / /bdag gi bsam pa'i don rnams kun/ /ji ltar smon bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /de nas gzungs rnams la me tog gi char dbab/ gdangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ bkra shis gang zhig lhag lha'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /rin chen sna tshogs 'bar ba lham me ltar/ /gang gis mchod na dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /mtshungs med rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig tshogs gnyis las grub cing / /sku lnga rab rdzogs ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /thugs rje che sprul khro bzhed rngams pa'i dpal/ /khro rgyal gshin rje gshed kyi bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dur khrod gnas mchog nas/ /'jig rten 'das dang sdug pa'i cha lugs 'chang / /bstan la gnod byed sgrol ba'i gnod sbyin dbang / /yam shud 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis kun gyi dpal du bkra shis pa/ /lhar bcas bkra shis bde legs bkra shis pa/ /ngo mtshar bkra shis mchog tu bkra shis pa/ /skyabs gsum bkra shis phun tshogs bkra shis shog /gzhan yang chos srung nor lha la sogs pa'i bkra shis gang shes brjod la/ sgrub khang du log nas tshogs yod na so so'i cho ga bya/ thun gtor spyi dang khyad par gnod sbyin gyi 'bul gtor rwa gzugs la nyin mo spos dang / mtshan mo dpal 'bar btsugs/ khrag chang dang bcas pa khyer la/ gtsang zhing dben pa'i gnas su phul ba ni/ kyai dbang ldan ma ru rtse'i dur khrod nas/ /mchong dmar brag la brten pa'i gnas bcas pa/ /sgrol 'gying chen po srog bdag dmar po dang / /srog bdud chen mo bse'i le phran can/ /lcam sring khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /las mkhan srog bdag dmar po 'khor dang bcas/ /sgrol byed bshan pa gri thogs brgyad po dang /

/rol bshan nyi shu rtsa gcig 'khor dang bcas/ /bdud dang gshin rje srin po sum stong dang / /btsan dmar stong gi dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /ma mo 'bum dang the'u rang stong la sogs/ /ston pa'i bka' nyan bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /dgra sha khrag gi mchod gtor༞ /gtsang ma phud kyi gser skyems༞ /rwa dmar khrag sbyar mchod yon༞ /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyen por 'bul/ /da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs chen por bzhes/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin gces par skyongs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi gnas lus longs spyod dang / /'khor dang yo byad zhon pa la sogs pa/ /bcol lo ltos so srung ma mthu rtsal can/ /nyin gsum bya ra rgyangs nas ma g.yel zhig /mtshan gsum mel tshe drung nas ma g.yel zhig /rtag tu sgrub pa'i gtong grogs ma g.yel zhig /bla med bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /sdang ba'i dgra la mngon pa'i rtags thong la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod/ /bla ma'i sku dgra bstan pa'i spyi dgra dang / /rnal 'byor dgos dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe/ /ma nyes log par lta ba'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /dpal mgon khyod kyi sgrol la bstan pa srungs/ /bla med bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /ces brjod la/ gtor sngags las bzhi'i phrin bcol dang bcas pas phul/ srid zhi dpal 'byor ma sogs bya/ yi ge brgya pa'i lhag chad kha bskang ba sogs bdag bskyed gang yin gyi mjug chog brtan bzhugs gshegs gsol sogs skabs su gang babs bkra shis kyi mtha' brgyan par bya'o// //ces gnod sbyin beg tse lcam dral gyi gzungs 'dzugs pa'i lag len gang bsam phrin las lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang chos tshul 'di la blo kha cung zad phyogs pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gnyags paṇa gyi yig cha dang /

tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs las byang sogs la gzhi byas lag len bklags chog tu bkod pa 'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na rtsa ba'i bla ma'i spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags nas dge des bsam don yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig yi ge pa ni bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis so// //dge legs 'phel// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ yam shud dmar po'i phyi rten 'dzugs pa'i cho ga PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
